# CopilotForge - Copilot Adoption

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-port.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Design and run organisation-wide or business-unit Microsoft AI adoption programmes, from readiness and scenarios through launch, reinforcement and measurement.

- **Layer:** adoption
- **Lead role:** Adoption Lead
- **Plugin name:** `copilotforge-copilot-adoption`

| Skill | Status | Lifecycle | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`adoption-measurement`](skills/adoption-measurement/SKILL.md) | draft | Discover, Measure, Improve | Defines how Copilot adoption is measured across usage, capability, behaviour change and business outcomes, with baselines set before launch, team or role-level reporting above a minimum group size, and feedback loops that change the programme. Use when setting adoption measures, when a sponsor asks whether Copilot is working, or when someone proposes tracking individual usage. |
| [`adoption-readiness`](skills/adoption-readiness/SKILL.md) | draft | Discover, Mobilise | Assesses whether an organisation or business unit is ready to adopt Microsoft Copilot across sponsorship, licences assigned versus used, IT-led technical enablement, data and permissions hygiene, approved-use guidance, support and communications, and records the gaps to close before launch. Use when licences have been bought or are about to be, before a launch date is fixed, or when early use has stalled. |
| [`launch-plan`](skills/launch-plan/SKILL.md) | draft | Mobilise, Enable, Launch | Plans a phased Copilot launch with onboarding by persona, executive and manager enablement, reinforcement through office hours and Champions, a support model and a feedback loop that keeps improving the programme. Use when readiness gaps are known and a rollout needs sequencing, when a big-bang launch is being proposed, or when a launch happened but nothing followed it. |
| [`scenario-discovery`](skills/scenario-discovery/SKILL.md) | draft | Discover, Envision, Enable | Segments the workforce into personas such as desk, hybrid and frontline workers, discovers role-based Copilot scenarios with business owners, prioritises them by value and frequency, and builds a scenario catalogue with prompt patterns that users can verify. Use when planning what people will actually do with Copilot, when usage is generic and shallow, or when a new team or role joins the rollout. |
